description:
Housekeeping Supervisor  (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: 10-Monats-Stelle / 10-month contract. Stellenantritt: 2026-08-01.

## This is what you move with us
• Quality Assurance: You conduct daily inspections of guest rooms, suites, and public areas, ensuring that our high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and service are consistently maintained.

• Operational Support: You actively support the Housekeeping team in daily operations and help ensure smooth workflows across all assigned areas.

• Team Coordination: You organize daily housekeeping activities, coordinate room assignments, and ensure that priorities are executed efficiently and on time.

• Training & Onboarding: You assist in the onboarding of new team members and provide ongoing on-the-job training and coaching to maintain and continuously improve service quality.

• Control & Documentation: You report maintenance issues, oversee Lost & Found procedures, and ensure compliance with internal policies as well as health, safety, and hygiene standards.

• Interdepartmental Communication: You work closely with the Front Office, Engineering, and Laundry teams to deliver an exceptional guest experience and ensure efficient communication between departments.

## This is you
You understand that outstanding housekeeping is often the art of the unseen – everything is impeccable, allowing guests to enjoy a flawless and comfortable stay.
• Experience: You have a professional background in hospitality and ideally previous experience as a Floor Supervisor, Housekeeping Supervisor, or in a similar role within a luxury hotel environment.

• Languages: You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of German, Italian, Portuguese, or any additional language is considered a strong asset.

• Organizational Skills: You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Resilience: You are physically fit, enjoy being hands-on, and appreciate the balance between operational responsibilities and administrative tasks.

• Personality: You possess a strong eye for detail, a proactive mindset, a positive attitude, and the ability to motivate and lead by example.

• Flexibility: You are willing to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays, according to operational needs.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Apply now

## Assistant Chef de Bar (m/w/d)
Grand Hotel Kronenhof

100%

This is what you move with usSupporting the Bar Manager in managing the team and organising the bar area (complaints management, staff management, staff training, shift planning)Ensuring exemplary guest service and smooth operations during shiftsPreparation and presentation of drinks in compliance with high quality standardsEnsuring cleanliness and tidiness in the bar areaCarrying out orders and stock management for the barCashing up on the TCPOS cash register system & preparing the daily accounts Working closely with the Bar Manager and other departments to ensure seamless serviceTraining and mentoring of bar staff to ensure excellent customer serviceAdhering to hotel policies and procedures in bar operations
This is youCompleted professional training At least 2 years of professional experience in the luxury hotel industry in the bar areaExcellent knowledge of German and English, knowledge of other languages an advantageExtensive knowledge in the preparation of classic and modern cocktails and other drinksKnowledge of cigars and advising guestsOrganisational talent Stylish appearance, friendliness and charismaAbility to work in a team, flexibility and a pronounced guest service orientationWe are looking for a long-term cooperation in this position.
BenefitsAt the Kulm Group, our people are the key to our success. That’s why we have a reputation for impeccable service. Our shared passion for high-end luxury, winter sports, haute cuisine and uncompromising service makes every stay unforgettable. When you work with us, we invest in you and provide you with the perfect platform to launch your career. All our team enjoy a wealth of amenities and perks, from comfortable accommodation and culinary delicacies, to our newly renovated staff lounge and free access to on-site fitness rooms. For us, providing the best employee experience is what sets our hospitality apart.    Competitive      salaryWe continually strive to find new ways to reward our teams,      providing development opportunities, access to facilities and generous      discounts throughout the year. We offer discounted stays to family and friends at the Grand Hotel      Kronenhof or Kulm Hotel for the special rate of CHF 150 or CHF 200 a night      including breakfast in a single or a double room.Parents and partners receive 20% off on meals and drinks at Chesa      al Parc, Kulm Country Club, The Pizzeria in St. Moritz or Le Pavillion in      Pontresina.40% off on spa treatments, coiffeur and private purchase of goods      and services.Free use of the tennis courts at Kulm Hotel St Moritz.Discounts on tennis and golf lessons.Free use of the golf course with a licence or driving range.Day ski pass for CHF 45 per person for Corvatsch.Diavolezza/Lagalb and 1 Corvatsch Ski Night for free.

## Housekeeping Director (m/w/d)
Kulm Hotel

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:
This is what you move with usAt Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, Housekeeping is the heart of our property. With 150 rooms and suites, 30 residences, staff accommodations, and magnificent public areas, we set benchmarks in alpine luxury hospitality. As Housekeeping Director, you are the strategic leader behind this demanding operation. You will lead the department with foresight, composure, and an uncompromising eye for aesthetics. In this key position, you will report directly to the EAM Rooms Division and be responsible for the Housekeeping department (approximately 50–80 employees):   Department Leadership & Vision: You oversee the overall aesthetics of the rooms division and ensure that Forbes, LQA, and our internal quality standards are not only achieved but consistently lived as benchmarks of excellence.   Management Leadership: You lead and coach the Housekeeping Manager and Laundry Manager, who oversee daily operations. Together, you continuously develop and enhance the departments.   Staff Accommodation & Residence Management: You hold overall responsibility for the administration and quality standards of staff housing and employee rooms. In addition, you serve as a professional and trusted point of contact for guests staying in our exclusive residences.   Financial Management: You are responsible for the department’s budget, monitor labor costs (P&L), coordinate purchasing activities, and plan investments for renovations and new acquisitions.   Cross-Department Collaboration: You work closely with Engineering, Laundry, and Front Office teams to ensure a seamless guest journey.   Sustainability & Innovation: You implement environmentally sustainable cleaning concepts and drive the digitalization of housekeeping processes.   Talent Development: You are responsible for long-term workforce planning, recruiting key positions, and developing talent within your large, international team.
This is youYou are an accomplished professional who has already demonstrated the ability to successfully and efficiently lead large teams in the luxury hospitality industry.   Experience: You have a long-standing career in Housekeeping within five-star hotels and have successfully held a senior leadership position (e.g., Executive Housekeeper or Director) in properties of comparable size.   Leadership Skills: You are a leader who inspires through expertise and personal integrity. You know how to structure processes without compromising the flexibility required in a luxury hospitality environment.   Training & Development: You are passionate about continuously developing and empowering your team.   Digital Affinity: Confident user of computers and standard business software.   Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English. As a large portion of our team speaks Italian or Portuguese, Italian language skills are a significant advantage in your daily work.   Analytical Thinking: You enjoy working with figures, budgeting, forecasting, and modern hotel management systems.   Personality: You are characterized by professionalism, discretion, and exceptionally high aesthetic standards. Even during peak season, you maintain calmness, focus, and a clear overview.   Why Kulm Hotel?   Opportunity to Shape the Future: A position of great trust with direct reporting to the General Manager and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the future of our properties, both operationally and culturally.   Recognition & Appreciation: An environment that values your expertise in people management and provides the freedom to establish modern leadership practices at a world-class level.   Exclusivity: Work at one of the world’s most prestigious hospitality destinations, alongside a team that places great importance on collaboration and mutual support.
BenefitsAt Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

## Assistant Restaurant Manager – Chesa al Parc (m/w/d)
Kulm Hotel

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:
This is what you move with usChesa al Parc is the culinary oasis for hotel guests, locals, and sports enthusiasts alike. Whether on our spacious sun terrace in summer, by the ice rink in winter, or inside our cozy restaurant, we serve Swiss specialties and international classics at the highest level. As Assistant Restaurant Manager, you are not only the operational backbone of the restaurant, but above all the face of the venue. You live and breathe hospitality and create memorable experiences our guests will cherish long after their visit.Your Responsabilities:Passion for Service: You manage your own station within our upscale à la carte service and anticipate the wishes of our discerning guests before they are even expressed.Leadership: In the absence of the Restaurant Manager, you confidently take charge of operations, coordinate daily service flow, and act as a reliable point of reference for our international team.Quality Assurance: You ensure our high service standards are consistently maintained and support smooth, harmonious cooperation between kitchen and service teams, both front and back of house.Training & Team Spirit: You assist with onboarding and training new team members while leading by example with a positive, hands-on attitude that motivates the entire team.
This is youQualifications: Completed training in hospitality, restaurant service, or a comparable qualification.Experience: At least 5 years of solid experience in upscale à la carte service. Initial leadership experience (e.g. as Shift Leader or Chef de Rang with responsibilities) is considered a strong advantage.Languages: Fluent German and good English skills are essential for daily guest interaction. Any additional language, especially Italian, is a valuable asset.Personality: You are highly resilient, remain calm and organized even during busy service periods, and maintain a clear overview at all times.Mindset: You have a natural, elegant, and warm presence. For you, hospitality is not just a job, but a true passion.
BenefitsAt Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Supervisore delle pulizie (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadina, Grigioni). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: 10-Monats-Stelle / contratto di 10 mesi. Stellenantritt: 2026-08-01. Questo è ciò che si muove con noi Quality Assurance: Conduci ispezioni giornaliere di camere, suite e aree pubbliche, assicurando che i nostri elevati standard di pulizia, presentazione e servizio sono costantemente mantenuti. Supporto Operativo: Supporti attivamente il team di pulizia nelle operazioni quotidiane e aiuta a garantire flussi di lavoro fluidi in tutte le aree assegnate. Coordinamento del team: Si organizzano attività di pulizia quotidiana, coordinare le assegnazioni delle camere, e garantire che le priorità siano eseguite in modo efficiente e puntuale. Formazione & Onboarding: assisti all'imbarco di nuovi membri del team e fornisci un continuo training on-the-job e coaching per mantenere e migliorare continuamente la qualità del servizio. Control & Documentation: Lei segnala i problemi di manutenzione, supervisiona le procedure Lost & Found e garantisce il rispetto delle politiche interne, nonché gli standard di salute, sicurezza e igiene. Questo sei tu che capisci che la pulizia eccezionale è spesso l'arte dell'invisibile – tutto è impeccabile, permettendo agli ospiti di godere di un soggiorno impeccabile e confortevole. Esperienza: Hai uno sfondo professionale nell'ospitalità e l'esperienza idealmente precedente come supervisore del pavimento, supervisore della pulizia, o in un ruolo simile in un ambiente di hotel di lusso. Lingue: Lei comunica fluentemente in inglese. La conoscenza di tedesco, italiano, portoghese o di qualsiasi altra lingua è considerata un bene forte. Competenze organizzative: Siete altamente organizzati, orientati ai dettagli, e in grado di priorizzare in modo efficace in un ambiente veloce. Resilienza: Tu sei fisicamente in forma, goditi di essere pratico e apprezzi l'equilibrio tra responsabilità operative e compiti amministrativi. Personalità: Possiedi un occhio forte per i dettagli, una mentalità proattiva, un atteggiamento positivo, e la capacità di motivare e guidare per esempio. Flessibilità: Lei è disposto a lavorare turni, compresi i fine settimana e i giorni festivi, secondo le esigenze operative. I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo.

Con 150 camere e suite, 30 residence, alloggi per il personale e magnifiche aree pubbliche, abbiamo stabilito i punti di riferimento nell'ospitalità di lusso alpino. In qualità di direttore della pulizia, lei è il leader strategico dietro questa impegnativa operazione. Potrai guidare il dipartimento con la vista, la compostezza e un occhio senza compromessi per l'estetica. In questa posizione chiave, riferirai direttamente alla EAM Rooms Division e sarai responsabile del reparto di pulizia (circa 50-80 dipendenti): Dipartimento Leadership & Vision: Si supervisiona l'estetica generale della divisione camere e assicurarsi che Forbes, LQA, e i nostri standard di qualità interna non sono solo raggiunti, ma costantemente vissuto come benchmark di eccellenza. Leadership di gestione: Lei guida e istruisce il direttore di pulizia e il responsabile della lavanderia, che supervisiona le operazioni quotidiane. Insieme, si sviluppa continuamente e migliorare i dipartimenti. Staff Accommodation & Residence Management: Lei ha la responsabilità generale per l'amministrazione e gli standard di qualità degli alloggi del personale e delle camere dei dipendenti. Inoltre, sei un punto di contatto professionale e affidabile per gli ospiti che soggiornano nelle nostre esclusive residenze. Gestione finanziaria: Lei è responsabile del bilancio del dipartimento, monitorare i costi del lavoro (P&L), coordinare le attività di acquisto e pianificare gli investimenti per i lavori di ristrutturazione e nuove acquisizioni. Collaborazione: Lei lavora a stretto contatto con i team di Ingegneria, Lavanderia e Front Office per garantire un viaggio ospiti senza interruzioni. Sostenibilità & innovazione: implementate concetti di pulizia eco-sostenibile e guidate la digitalizzazione dei processi di pulizia. Talent Development: Lei è responsabile per la pianificazione della forza lavoro a lungo termine, l'assunzione di posizioni chiave, e lo sviluppo di talento all'interno del suo grande team internazionale. Questo sei un professionista esperto che ha già dimostrato la capacità di condurre con successo ed efficientemente grandi team nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso. Esperienza: Hai una lunga carriera in Housekeeping all'interno di hotel a cinque stelle e hai ricoperto con successo una posizione di leadership senior (ad esempio, Executive Housekeeper o Director) in proprietà di dimensioni simili. Competenze di leadership: Sei un leader che ispira esperienza e integrità personale. Sai come strutturare i processi senza compromettere la flessibilità necessaria in un ambiente di ospitalità di lusso. Training & Development: Sei appassionato di sviluppare e potenziare continuamente il tuo team. Affinità digitale: utente sicuro di computer e software aziendale standard. Competenze linguistiche: sei fluente in tedesco e inglese. Come una grande parte del nostro team parla italiano o portoghese, le competenze linguistiche italiane sono un vantaggio significativo nel vostro lavoro quotidiano. Pensare analitico: Ti piace lavorare con figure, budgeting, previsione e moderni sistemi di gestione alberghiera. Personalità: Lei è caratterizzato da professionalità, discrezione e standard estetici eccezionalmente elevati. Anche durante la stagione di punta, si mantiene la calma, la messa a fuoco, e una chiara panoramica. Perché Kulm Hotel? Opportunità a Formare il Futuro: Una posizione di grande fiducia con un reporting diretto al Direttore Generale e l'opportunità di avere un impatto duraturo sul futuro delle nostre proprietà, sia operativamente che culturalmente. Riconoscimento e apprezzamento: Un ambiente che valorizza le tue competenze nella gestione delle persone e offre la libertà di stabilire pratiche di leadership moderne a livello mondiale. Esclusività: Lavorare in una delle mete più prestigiose dell’ospitalità al mondo, insieme a un team che pone grande importanza sulla collaborazione e sul reciproco sostegno. BenefitsAt Kulm Group, i nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo. Offriamo interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, sistemazioni confortevoli, pasti convenienti nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi.
